name: cascade-design
description: Apply proportional design to UI changes and refactors: appearance, components, forms, parameter configuration, search, navigation, layouts, workflows, responsive behavior and data/canvas interfaces; create mockups and review visual/accessibility evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Design checks and mockups for UI changes and refactors.
interface.longDescription: Include Design at an appropriate depth for UI changes and refactors. Choose existing UX, design-system, mockup, visual or accessibility methods for the affected topic; preserve accepted product/design authority and host implementation ownership.
defaultPrompt: Review the design impact of this UI change at an appropriate depth.
Create responsive mockups and a frontend handoff for this product flow.
Review visual quality and accessibility across the affected viewports and states.
